Limb-girdle muscular dystrophy; intellectual disability and speech/language delay occur in 2/3 patients, supporting neurologic involvement.

Inherited tricarboxylic acid cycle energy-metabolism defect; supplied evidence does not establish common damage to a particular additional organ.

Vertebral and metaphyseal skeletal dysplasia; blue sclerae do not establish ocular functional damage, and feeding difficulty alone does not establish gastrointestinal damage.

Defining congenital limb ectrodactyly and structural heart disease; facial dysmorphism alone does not establish another affected axis.

Congenital adrenal hypoplasia and deficient pituitary luteinizing hormone are defining endocrine abnormalities.
Defining sweat-gland and hair abnormalities affect skin; missing, small and conical teeth affect the gastrointestinal axis.
Neoplasm originates in lymphatic vessels and is classified as a vascular neoplasm; lymphatic vessel origin does not imply lymphoma or immune disease.
